tools.name: get_student_overview
tools.description: Returns the authenticated NoBrainner student learning overview: profile basics, progress, decks, recent review grades, and weak deck signals.

tools.name: get_user_stats
tools.description: Returns detailed NoBrainner student learning statistics: accuracy rate, grade distribution, active/total deck counts, streaks, total reviews, estimated study hours, and 30-day accuracy history.

tools.name: get_leaderboards
tools.description: Returns weekly NoBrainner global leaderboard rankings, streak leaders, and the authenticated user position.

tools.name: get_review_timeline
tools.description: Returns daily NoBrainner study activity for the last N days.

tools.name: get_deck_list
tools.description: Returns the authenticated NoBrainner student deck list with status, card counts, source, study settings, and sync metadata.

tools.name: get_deck_detail
tools.description: Returns one NoBrainner deck and a paginated page of cards. Use this when the student asks about a specific deck or wants card-level context.

tools.name: get_weak_cards
tools.description: Returns the cards with the strongest recent Again/Hard signal, including card text when available.

tools.name: create_deck_draft
tools.description: Creates a NoBrainner deck draft from structured cards. BEFORE DRAFTING: Ask the user if they want audio generated for their cards. If yes, and the user is Pro (check via get_student_overview), ask if they prefer a premium female or premium male voice (Chirp3-HD). Free users receive standard voice (N

tools.name: preview_deck_draft
tools.description: Previews a pending NoBrainner deck draft before it is saved.

tools.name: save_deck_draft
tools.description: Saves a confirmed NoBrainner deck draft into the student account as a ready deck. Only call after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: get_deck_settings
tools.description: Returns the current study settings for a NoBrainner deck: card orientation (normal/reversed), daily new card limit, daily review limit, font size, font family, and auto-audio. Use deckFingerprint from get_deck_list or get_student_overview.

tools.name: update_deck_settings
tools.description: Updates study settings for a NoBrainner deck. Always show the user what will change and ask for explicit confirmation before calling this tool. All setting fields are optional — only provided fields are changed. cardOrientation: normal (front→back) or reversed (back→front). newLimit: max new cards p

tools.name: get_shared_catalog
tools.description: Browses public community shared decks available on NoBrainner. Optionally filter by language, category, or searchQuery. Returns shareCodes, title, card count, and share URLs.

tools.name: import_shared_deck
tools.description: Imports a shared community deck directly into the authenticated student NoBrainner account. Accepts either a full share URL (e.g. https://nobrainner.xyz/share/ownerUid:deckFingerprint) or a raw share code (e.g. ownerUid:deckFingerprint).

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "update_deck_settings" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "update_deck_settings" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_student_overview, get_user_stats, get_review_timeline, get_deck_settings, get_shared_catalog · Private data: create_deck_draft, update_deck_settings · Public sink: get_shared_catalog, import_shared_deck.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_student_overview, get_user_stats, get_review_timeline, get_deck_settings, get_shared_catalog · Private data: create_deck_draft, update_deck_settings · Public sink: get_shared_catalog, import_shared_deck

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
